page: Sentinel Roadmap — From L1.5 to Next-Gen Security

current_state.limitation: Static analysis can be evaded via code obfuscation, dynamic module loading, or malicious third-party dependencies.
current_state.note: L1.5 is what runs in production today via /api/audit-skill. L1.6 is code-complete but not yet integrated into the production endpoint.

roadmap.name: Enhanced Static Analysis with Semgrep + Secret Scanning
roadmap.problem: L1.5 only analyzes metadata (README, package.json). It doesn't look at the actual code, so it misses hardcoded secrets, insecure patterns, and known vulnerabilities in dependencies.
roadmap.solution: Clone the repo and run: (1) Semgrep with MCP-specific rules for prompt injection, command injection, hardcoded credentials, dangerous filesystem access, SSRF, tool spoofing; (2) Gitleaks for secret detection; (3) OSV-Scanner/npm audit for dependency vulnerabilities; (4) Hygiene checks (license, manifest).
roadmap.scoring: Weighted 0-10: Secrets (40%), Vulnerabilities (30%), Static analysis (20%), Hygiene (10%). Critical secret = instant 0.
rules_categories: Prompt injection in tool descriptions (5 rules)
MCP-specific patterns (3 rules: tool spoofing, missing schema, env var leakage)
roadmap.note: Runs via GitHub Actions. Installs semgrep + gitleaks + osv-scanner automatically.

roadmap.name: Dynamic Analysis in Sandbox (DAST) — IMPLEMENTED
roadmap.problem: Static analysis (SAST) can be evaded via code obfuscation, dynamic module loading, or malicious third-party dependencies.
roadmap.solution: Execute each MCP server in an ephemeral sandbox. Monitor syscalls during test execution to detect suspicious behavior (e.g., a text formatter trying to read SSH keys or open unexpected network sockets).

monitors: network attempts (impossible with --network none, but check logs for ECONNREFUSED)
implementation.triggers: Manual (workflow_dispatch) or automatic on new issue submission

roadmap.name: Continuous Supply Chain Audit
roadmap.problem: A server secure today can become vulnerable tomorrow if a dependency suffers a supply chain attack.
roadmap.solution: Automated periodic re-scanning of dependency trees against vulnerability databases. Compromised skills auto-quarantine.

roadmap.name: Automated Red Teaming vs Prompt Injection
roadmap.problem: Detecting Tool Description Injection is extremely difficult with static rules.
roadmap.solution: Adversarial evaluation sub-module with specialized LLMs that systematically attack tool descriptions using jailbreaking techniques.

roadmap.name: Cryptographic Code Signing
roadmap.problem: Source code in external GitHub repos could be modified after Sentinel analysis.
roadmap.solution: Sentinel generates a signed hash after analysis. MCP clients verify the signature before execution.

platform_improvements.name: Risk Level Classification (Green/Yellow/Red)
platform_improvements.description: Skills categorized by system resource access. Allows granular security policies.

platform_improvements.name: Community Feedback Loop
platform_improvements.description: Anonymous endpoint for reporting unexpected behavior, failures, or suspected malicious activity.

platform_improvements.name: Advanced Search Filters
platform_improvements.description: Filter by license, audit status, risk level, architecture.

platform_improvements.name: Maintainer-Verified Program
platform_improvements.description: Simplified verification via PGP commit signatures or verified GitHub accounts + lightweight KYC.

honest_disclosure: L1.6 is code-complete but NOT yet running in production. The production /api/audit-skill endpoint still uses L1.5. L1.6 will be integrated when we set up CI/CD with Semgrep/Gitleaks/OSV-Scanner installed on the runner.
